title: Articles
note: Authoring law: a/an = first time / one job·thing. the = same thing again (a X already in the gap line) OR only-one (situational). Never bare CZ alone as the only cue for the. · names from the GLUE name pool · 2026-08-06 re-lexified onto pool-legal vocabulary · 2026-08-17 MOVED from path slot 18 to slot 5 (James: articles are demanded from slot 2 and were taught 16 units late — 84 sentences owed) and re-lexified again onto the much smaller slot-5 pool, where the only verbs available are be and have. Eight words the unit must own to teach its own content are declared via `lemma`: apple, egg, hour, office, university, old, water, music. Keep them — a/an cannot be taught without a vowel-sound noun, and zero article cannot be taught without an uncountable.

items.cz: Mám telefon. (jedna věc — poprvé)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.cz: Mám tašku. (jedna taška — poprvé)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.cz: On je unavený student. (a + přídavné jméno + podstatné jméno)
items.explanation: a goes before the whole group: a + adjective + noun.
items.explanation_cz: a stojí před celou skupinou: a + přídavné jméno + podstatné jméno.

items.cz: Ona má auto. (jedna věc — poprvé)
items.explanation: One thing, first time → a (not the yet).

items.en: There is a dog in my house.
items.cz: V mém domě je pes. (poprvé zmíněná věc → a)
items.gap: There is ____ dog in my house.
accepts: There is a dog in my house.
There's a dog in my house.
items.explanation: First mention of one thing → a.
items.explanation_cz: První zmínka o jedné věci → a.

items.cz: Ona je učitelka. (povolání → a/an + povolání; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: On je doktor. (povolání → a/an + povolání; ne the — není to „ten konkrétní“ doktor)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: Petr je student. (povolání/role; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: Můj bratr je doktor. (povolání → a; ne the)
items.explanation: Job words need a/an: She is a teacher.

items.cz: Mám jablko. (jedno · samohláska → an)
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Ona má staré auto. (jedno · samohláska old → an)
items.explanation: Listen to the next word, not the noun: an old car.
items.explanation_cz: Rozhoduje další slovo, ne podstatné jméno: an old car.

items.cz: Máme hodinu. (jedna hodina · němé h → an)
items.explanation: Hour starts with a vowel sound (silent h) → an hour.

items.cz: Tohle je kancelář. (samohláska → an)
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Mám vejce. (jedno · samohláska → an)
items.explanation: Next word starts with a vowel sound → an.

items.cz: Tohle je univerzita. (zvuk yu- → a university, ne an; první zmínka, ne the)
items.explanation: University starts with a /j/ sound ("you") → a, not an.

items.en: I have a book. The book is in my bag.
items.cz: Mám knihu. Ta kniha je v mé tašce.
items.gap: I have a book. ____ book is in my bag.
accepts: I have a book. The book is in my bag.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: This is a car. The car is old.
items.cz: Tohle je auto. To auto je staré.
items.gap: This is a car. ____ car is old.
accepts: This is a car. The car is old.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: I have a phone. The phone is in my car.
items.cz: Mám telefon. Ten telefon je v mém autě.
items.gap: I have a phone. ____ phone is in my car.
accepts: I have a phone. The phone is in my car.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: There is a dog. The dog is in my house.
items.cz: Je tu pes. Ten pes je v mém domě. (existuje — There is/are…)
items.gap: There is a dog. ____ dog is in my house.
accepts: There is a dog. The dog is in my house.
There's a dog. The dog is in my house.
items.explanation: We already said a dog. Now we know which one → the.
items.explanation_cz: Už víme, o kterého psa jde → the.

items.en: He has a bag. The bag is in the car.
items.cz: On má tašku. Ta taška je v autě.
items.gap: He has a bag. ____ bag is in the car.
accepts: He has a bag. The bag is in the car.
He's got a bag. The bag is in the car.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: She has a friend. The friend is a teacher.
items.cz: Ona má kamarádku. Ta kamarádka je učitelka.
items.gap: She has a friend. ____ friend is a teacher.
accepts: She has a friend. The friend is a teacher.
She's got a friend. The friend is a teacher.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: There is a teacher here. The teacher is tired.
items.cz: Je tu učitel. Ten učitel je unavený. (existuje — There is/are…)
items.gap: There is a teacher here. ____ teacher is tired.
accepts: There is a teacher here. The teacher is tired.
There's a teacher here. The teacher is tired.
items.explanation: Second time (or we know which one) → the.

items.en: There is only one doctor here. The doctor is my friend.
items.cz: Je tu jen jeden doktor. Ten doktor je můj kamarád. (existuje — There is/are…)
items.gap: There is only one doctor here. ____ doctor is my friend.
accepts: There is only one doctor here. The doctor is my friend.
There's only one doctor here. The doctor is my friend.
items.explanation: Only one in the situation — we both know which → the.
items.explanation_cz: Jen jeden v dané situaci → the.

items.en: There is only one student here. The student is tired.
items.cz: Je tu jen jeden student. Ten student je unavený. (existuje — There is/are…)
items.gap: There is only one student here. ____ student is tired.
accepts: There is only one student here. The student is tired.
There's only one student here. The student is tired.
items.explanation: Only one in the situation — we both know which → the.
items.explanation_cz: Jen jeden v dané situaci → the.

items.cz: Mám psy. (množné číslo obecně — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article. Not a dogs / the dogs (unless specific dogs).

items.cz: Ona má knihy. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

items.cz: Máme auta. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

items.cz: Oni mají telefony. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

items.cz: Oni jsou studenti. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural after be → no article. One student, but a: He is a student.
items.explanation_cz: Množné po be → bez členu. Jednotné: He is a student.

items.cz: Tohle je voda. (nepočitatelné — bez a/an)
items.explanation: Uncountable (water, milk, music…) → usually no a/an.

items.cz: Tohle je hudba. (nepočitatelné — bez a/an)
items.explanation: Uncountable (water, milk, music…) → usually no a/an.

items.cz: Máme kamarády. (množné číslo — bez členu)
items.explanation: Plural in general → no article.

cards.title: Articles · the idea
cards.body: Small words before a noun. In Czech you often say nothing — in English you usually choose **a / an**, **the**, or **nothing**.
points: Missing a/an/the before **one** person or thing is a very common error
You have already said *I am a student* — this is the unit that explains the **a**
First goal: choose the right option — use the map on the next card

cards.title: a, an, the — or nothing?
cards.body: One question first. Then the kind of noun.
points: **a / an** = one singular countable (first time / one of many)
**no article** = plurals in general, or uncountables (water, music…)

cards.title: a or an?
points: Listen to the **sound**, not only the letter
**a** + consonant sound: a bag, a teacher, a university (yoo-)
**an** + vowel sound: an apple, an office, an hour (silent h)

rows: a phone · a student · a tired student
an apple · an egg · an hour

cards.title: When: the (and a → the)
points: You said it before (**a** book → **the** book)
Only one in the situation (**the** doctor here · **the** student here)

cards.title: Common A1 mistakes
points: Do not leave the noun empty when you mean **one** person or thing

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: One of many (first time) → a/an. We know which → the. Plurals / uncountables often → nothing.
points: I have a book. ___ book is in my bag. → **The**
Harder zero patterns (school, hospital, countries…) come later
